goals: Tạo giá trị tri thức hữu ích, chính xác, khác biệt

google_sources.principle: Utility relative to query, relevance, quality and users first
People-first, accuracy, effort, originality, skill, truthful Who/How/Why
Non-commodity content; normal SEO fundamentals, no fan-out page multiplication
Avoid scaled content abuse and deceptive claims

rubric.name: Task utility
rubric.evidence: User task and actual section supporting completion; hub/legal/reference evaluated by its purpose

rubric.name: Distinct contribution
rubric.evidence: Specific comparison with independent resources; no uniqueness claim from heading count alone

rubric.name: Technical accuracy
rubric.evidence: Claim ledger, original sources, executable tests with declared domain and limitations

rubric.name: Evidence accessibility
rubric.evidence: Original DOI/standards links, verifiable citations, distinguish site commentary from source

rubric.name: Reader usability
rubric.evidence: Direct answer, worked example, navigation, accessible reading; no arbitrary word count

rubric.name: Editorial transparency
rubric.evidence: Truthful author/editor identity and methodology; no invented credentials or testing

rules: No composite score represented as Google's ranking score.
No invented original research, timing or benchmark.
Do not require novel experiment on every page; useful accurate definitions/hubs may satisfy purpose.
No automatic pruning based on length, AI authorship or lexical overlap.
Do not assert ranking factors from CTR/dwell time.
Keep immutable page hash, exact section and reproducible test evidence.
Protect production, all 17 tools, URLs, canonicals and preview noindex.
WS6 final gate incorporates WS7; pilot evidence does not certify full article.

external_reference_sample.role: Standard recurrence and baseline tutorial; not proof site is unique
Edlib peer-reviewed implementation; distinguishes global and semiglobal and reports benchmarks; site must not claim novelty for these alone
Modern exact alignment comparison and band doubling; reference for algorithm context

pages.user_task: Explain standard Levenshtein distance and guide reader to deeper material
pages.evidence: Intro currently equates algorithm and edit distance family; definitions differ on /edit-distance
pages.action: Correct identity distinction; preserve historical URL and add simple verified example only if useful
Evaluate category labels and navigation; not necessary to invent original experiments for a hub

pages.user_task: Understand family of edit-distance models and select relevant variant
pages.evidence: Formal Definition; Worked Matrix; Distance and Edit Script Are Different Outputs
pages.action: Verify examples, normalize model names, connect standard model to home, test matrix against oracle

pages.user_task: Interpret edits and reconstruct valid scripts
pages.evidence: Example: Kitten to Sitting; The Optimal Edit Script May Not Be Unique
pages.action: Add or verify reproducible script application tests and coordinate conventions; avoid duplicating algorithm proofs

pages.user_task: Distinguish search formulations, thresholds and numerical approximation
pages.evidence: Pairwise Edit Distance and Approximate Search Are Different Problems; A Practical Architecture
pages.action: Build verified substring-vs-global counterexample; link Navarro analysis while retaining DOI

pages.user_task: Resolve technical terms without reading entire tutorials
pages.evidence: Concepts that should not be conflated; Core notation
pages.action: Check short definitions against entity owner pages and stable anchors; no word-count target

pages.user_task: Choose a comparison model by mathematical properties and representation
pages.evidence: Metric axioms; Technical References with five unlinked entries
pages.action: Verify metric counterexamples and add verified original citations; avoid treating all scores as metrics

pages.user_task: Select algorithm by input shape, cost model, threshold and workload
pages.evidence: Hub describes classical DP, bit-parallel, automata and indexing
pages.action: Consider evidence-backed comparison matrix; no fabricated fastest-method ranking

pages.user_task: Implement correct unit-cost DP and understand proof/traceback
pages.evidence: ux-section-34 one-row pseudocode; 3976 differential checks passed
pages.action: Publish exact test contract and reproducible corpus after staged review; traceback/weighted claims remain untested

pages.user_task: Implement bounded exact distance efficiently for small k
pages.evidence: ux-section-57 full-row clear; 27832 correctness checks passed; operation counts demonstrate extra quadratic work
pages.action: Clarify dense listing actual complexity and provide tested compact-band implementation; do not claim runtime gains until benchmarked

pages.user_task: Implement word-parallel global distance with correct masks and boundaries
pages.evidence: ux-section-30 global pseudocode; 3976 checks passed including 64-symbol cases
pages.action: Publish reproducible code-point test evidence; independently test original search mode and multiword algorithm before certifying

pages.user_task: Understand farthest-reaching states and LCE acceleration
pages.evidence: Reference bounded-distance pseudocode; Testing the farthest-reaching invariant
pages.action: Test against full DP and separate actual LCE preprocessing assumptions; original pattern-search result distinct

pages.user_task: Understand block tabulation and model assumptions
pages.evidence: Correctness argument; Differential testing; Testing block-table correctness
pages.action: Validate small block lookup tables and cost assumptions; do not claim measured performance or novelty without evidence

pages.user_task: Construct finite-state bounded match language and prune dictionary search
pages.evidence: Correctness theorem; Testing determinization; Testing trie intersection
pages.action: Compare accepted strings against oracle over finite test corpus; verify NFA/DFA semantics and trie pruning

pages.user_task: Design no-false-negative filter and exact verifier
pages.evidence: ux-section-8 Exact Filtering Means No False Negatives; ux-section-16 q-gram is not edit distance
pages.action: Test multiset q-gram and threshold candidate recall; distinguish exact retrieval from approximation
